title: E0073: Weak cryptographic hash
plain_english: Hashing passwords with weak, fast algorithms such as MD5 or SHA1 is unsafe. Use a dedicated password hashing function such as `password_hash()`.
why_matters: MD5 and SHA1 are designed for speed, not password storage. Attackers can: - Crack password hashes quickly using rainbow tables or GPU brute force - Recover common passwords in a short time - Compromise many user accounts if hashes are exposed
bad_example:
$hash = md5($password);   // weak and fast
$hash = sha1($password);  // weak and fast
what_it_checks: `crypt()` without a proper salt or cost parameter
